name: Tracker links (Jira/GitHub deep links)
description: Link types connecting Mockarty entities to external trackers: issue↔Jira ticket and mock↔GitHub issue, with URL templates that turn a stored key into a clickable deep link. Declarative, no code.

links.name: Jira ticket
links.description: Link an issue to its Jira counterpart.

links.name: GitHub issue
links.description: Link a mock to the GitHub issue that motivated it.
